stackDivergence.rationale: Original source responsibilities retain actual RTL/UNO owners and contracts. Explicit disposal, borrowed UTF16 views, pointer-address cells, compiler overload witnesses and realm-local execution bind the browser host; physical native ABI/thread guarantees remain unqualified.

preservedResponsibilities: Original SotStorage::GetFormatID/GetVersion native XStorage metadata responsibilities. The legacy compound-file SotStorage engine is separate and not supplied by this namespace binding.
omittedResponsibilities: The native clipboard registry/helper slice does not implement the legacy compound storage engine or supply a positive native XStorage provider; its earlier scoped branch coverage gap remains open.
Independent native compiled module differential, physical ABI/allocator/mutex/thread lifetime and runtime shutdown are unqualified.
Complete DOCX/XLSX model/filter/package/desktop/mobile UI import-export acceptance remains unfinished; existing browser open/save/autosave/recovery choices are retained.
